extraction.document_summary: FWD Life Protection is a participating whole of life insurance policy that combines whole-life coverage with flexibility to draw income when you need it. It provides a boosted death cover via a “Life Protection Booster” where you can choose a multiplier factor of 2x, 3x, or 5x, and a minimum protection level (MPL) age option of 75 or 85; after the MPL age starts reducing, the boosted coverage is reduced by 10% annually for 5 years (so you maintain 50% of boosted coverage). For payouts, you can convert up to 80% of policy value (from as early as age 55) into annual income, with a customised payout term from as short as 10 years up to age 100, plus a guaranteed 10% additional booster on income payouts. Buyers should note that the brochure states certain conditions (e.g., pre-existing conditions) and exclusions may make benefits not payable, and that waiting periods may apply for certain benefits.
quality_notes: Brochure clearly names the base product (FWD Life Protection) and multiple add-on riders, and provides several explicit benefit mechanics (death payout basis, income conversion, retrenchment waiver).
Most numeric limits for CI riders are qualitative (number of conditions), while payout amounts for the early CI rider are specified (e.g., 20% of rider sum insured; max S$25,000).
Some important items are referenced but not fully detailed (e.g., underwriting/actual rider sum insured limits, waiting period specifics, full list of exclusions).

policies.quick_summary: Participating whole of life insurance with boosted coverage (multiplier 2x/3x/5x and MPL age option 75/85) plus the ability to convert up to 80% of policy value into annual income from age 55 (income payout term 10 years to up to age 100) with an additional 10% booster on income payouts. Supports retrenchment premium waiver (12 months if laid off and unemployed for at least 30 consecutive days before 65) and premium deferment up to 12 months (after meeting conditions). Includes attached critical illness riders (Early CI Protection/CI Protection) and CI-related premium waiver riders (named). Critically, the brochure states that pre-existing conditions and exclusions may result in no benefits payable, and waiting periods may apply for certain benefits.
coverage_scope: Whole-of-life financial protection with death payout linked to MPL and sum insured
Annual income payout via conversion of policy value (up to 80%)
Lifestage purchase option to increase coverage without good health evidence
Attached critical illness/ICU and premium waiver rider benefits (via add-on riders)
policies.coverage_term_description: Whole of life insurance; the booster/boosted coverage is designed to continue throughout life with an MPL age option (75 or 85) and a subsequent 5-year annual 10% reduction schedule for the boosted coverage.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Preferred premium payment term of 5, 10, 15, 20 or 25 years.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Participating whole of life insurance; brochure refers to guaranteed surrender value, reversionary bonus and terminal bonus as components of policy value.
important_caveats: The brochure states that certain conditions such as pre-existing conditions and exclusions may cause no benefits to be payable.
The brochure states waiting period may be applicable for certain benefits.
Policy value is defined as Surrender Value components after deducting outstanding fees/charges/amounts owed.
